recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as the reconciliation for FHIR-53025. The core ElementDefinition, search parameter, and example already match the accepted request; no additional core source work is recommended for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-53025 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 Imaging Integration change request to revert FHIR-50894 and use ImagingStudy.procedure, not ImagingStudy.partOf, to identify the performed Procedure resource during which the ImagingStudy data was produced.
initial_application: Commit 235456643091f44f295a33d4e307de5c945fb7b9, merged through HL7/fhir#3729, applied most of the issue by changing the active StructureDefinition, procedure search parameter, example, notes, and mapping exception. Follow-up mapping commits 4ee338d0947581a6c88706c8a12810b29c733412 and 4bfa3ce24d7cfa48173d629089b208711d521d25 refined the Event mapping exception. The notes still retained stale partOf wording and the active SVG diagram still showed the removed partOf row plus the old CodeableReference procedure row.
additional_context: FHIR-50866 established related DiagnosticReport rationale for keeping .procedure to distinguish performed procedures from requested procedures. FHIR-50894 then moved ImagingStudy performed procedures to partOf before FHIR-53025 explicitly reversed that approach. FHIR-52026 later corrected the requested-procedure side of the same Imaging Study Procedures note to ServiceRequest, leaving only the performed-procedure sentence and diagram stale. source/fhir.ini actively lists imagingstudy=ImagingStudy and assigns it to the ii work group.
reconciliation: Updated source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml to say the performed procedure is the Procedure referenced by the imaging study's procedure element. Updated source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy.svg to show ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure), remove the stale ImagingStudy.partOf row and old CodeableReference procedure row, and close the gap in the active diagram.
source_changes: source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml: clarified that the performed procedure is the Procedure referenced by the imaging study's procedure element.

source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy.svg: replaced the stale partOf diagram row with ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure), removed the old CodeableReference procedure row, and reduced the ImagingStudy box height.

related_jiras.note: Related DiagnosticReport decision to keep .procedure for performed-procedure clarity rather than using .partOf.
Prior Applied ImagingStudy decision moved performed procedures to ImagingStudy.partOf; FHIR-53025 explicitly reverted it.
Later source change corrected requested-procedure wording in the same notes section to ServiceRequest, helping bound this reconciliation to performed-procedure wording and the diagram.
